metadata.description: Legacy CWE entries missing from the 944-entry Stage 4 knowledge base but present in SCRBench ground truth.
metadata.note: These entries preserve historical benchmark labels. Several are categories or deprecated entries and are prohibited for modern vulnerability mapping by current CWE guidance.

cwes.name: Data Processing Errors
cwes.description: Legacy CWE category covering weaknesses in functionality that processes data, including manipulation of input to retrieve or save information.
remediation_steps: Validate data-processing assumptions and enforce safe handling of input throughout processing.
cwes.impact: depends on the underlying data-processing weakness
cwes.hint: Legacy category; inspect the concrete data-processing weakness demonstrated by the code.

cwes.name: 7PK - Security Features
cwes.description: Legacy CWE category for security-feature weaknesses involving authentication, access control, confidentiality, cryptography, privilege management, and related protections.
remediation_steps: Identify and address the concrete underlying security-feature weakness rather than relying on this broad category.
cwes.hint: Legacy category; verify the exact security feature and underlying weakness.

cwes.name: Credentials Management Errors
cwes.description: Legacy CWE category grouping weaknesses related to creation, storage, transmission, validation, and management of credentials.
remediation_steps: Identify the concrete credential-management weakness and apply controls appropriate to storage, transport, validation, and lifecycle management.
cwes.hint: Legacy category; inspect the exact credential-management failure.

cwes.name: Permissions, Privileges, and Access Controls
cwes.description: Legacy CWE category for weaknesses in the management of permissions, privileges, and other security features used to perform access control.
remediation_steps: Verify authorization at each protected operation and enforce least privilege using a concrete access-control mechanism.
cwes.impact: unauthorized access, privilege misuse, or protected-action bypass
cwes.hint: Legacy category; look for missing or incorrect authorization, permission, or privilege enforcement.

cwes.name: Cryptographic Issues
cwes.description: Legacy CWE category covering weaknesses in the design and implementation of confidentiality and integrity mechanisms, including encryption, encoding, hashing, and cryptographic libraries.
remediation_steps: Identify the concrete cryptographic weakness and use current algorithms, sound key management, and correct cryptographic APIs.
cwes.hint: Legacy category; inspect the exact cryptographic primitive, configuration, or protocol weakness.

cwes.name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
cwes.description: Deprecated CWE for exposure of sensitive information through debug log files. Current CWE guidance points to CWE-532 for insertion of sensitive information into log files.
remediation_steps: Do not write sensitive information to debug logs and restrict access to log files.
cwes.hint: Look for secrets, credentials, personal data, or other sensitive values written to debug logs.
